description: This file defines a base activity class 'SampleActivityBase' that extends FragmentActivity, serving as a common foundation for Android sample applications. It includes methods for initializing logging and basic activity lifecycle management.

classes.name: SampleActivityBase
classes.description: A base class for activities that provides logging setup and lifecycle management for Android samples.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Android activity lifecycle method, called when the activity is created.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Android activity lifecycle method, called when the activity becomes visible.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up logging by attaching a LogWrapper to the Log system and outputs a 'Ready' message.
